hypothesis: Truthful motion history helps under stationary dynamics but becomes a causally harmful stale prior immediately after abrupt regime changes.

stationary_control.type: phase-matched reset under stationary Level 1 dynamics

secondary_gates: (RANDOM_RESET-FULL)_L1 <= 0 is preferred; a positive value weakens the stale-prior interpretation
(STALE_HOLD-FULL)_L3 < 0 is the expected causal mechanism sign
stop_rule: Stop if the primary reversal is absent/reversed or if L3 RESET_CHANGE does not beat its matched L3 RANDOM_RESET control. Do not tune history length, stale duration, detector thresholds, or learned gates using outcome data.

gpu_16gb.note: DynamicWAM HeadFlowRunner hard-codes batch dimension 1; do not change the benchmark runtime merely to fill VRAM.
